result.headline: Hotter than expected: +0.4% headline and +0.3% core, both 0.1 point above forecasts
points: Headline prices rose 0.4% in the month vs 0.3% expected (September was +0.6%); core, which strips out food and energy, rose 0.3% vs 0.2% expected (Yahoo Finance).
Food rose 0.5% and energy 0.7%; no yearly rate was published because October 2025 data were never collected (Yahoo Finance).
Rate-hike bets firmed: CME FedWatch showed 90% odds of a quarter-point December hike and 10% for a half-point (Kiplinger).
Yields jumped (2-year +18.9bp to 4.74%, 10-year 4.99%) and the Nasdaq fell 0.74%; gold dropped about 2.6% (Kiplinger, Trading Economics).
For you: this matches the 'hot print' case in the preview: growth shares and gold (SGLN -1.6%) fell, while VWRP had already closed in London before the US slide.

upside: A soft print would pull yields down, which helps long-duration growth shares (TickerVelocity).

means: Nvidia guided $108bn revenue and a 74% gross margin; the consensus ($108.8bn) is only just above its own guide.
It beat in 7 of the last 8 quarters but the shares fell after 5 of them. What moves it is the outlook for the next quarter, not the beat.

Its results also move your grid ETF and your Vanguard fund, where Nvidia is one of the largest holdings.

You hold it for a few months, so this report falls inside your holding window.

stories.headline: Altimeter and Atreides ask Nvidia's board not to rush a CEO pick, keeping a Huang return possible

impacts.why: Board says it is still choosing a search firm and hasn't formally engaged candidates; shares lost about $573bn of value over the week [1].

sources.title: Big Shareholders and 3,000 Nvidia Employees Want Jensen Huang Back

stories.summary: Brad Gerstner (Altimeter) and Gavin Baker (Atreides) wrote to Nvidia's board on 13 Nov asking for a measured CEO search that leaves the door open to Jensen Huang returning; the letter does not seek a vote or new directors. A 'Stand with Jensen' petition passed 55,000 names by Saturday, though only about 3,600 claimed to be current staff. 24/7 Wall St. estimates the two funds own only about 0.04% of Nvidia, and the board had not responded.

stories.headline: Microsoft warns phishers are exploiting last week's Microsoft 365 outage

sources.title: Microsoft Warns of Active Password Stealing Attack Exploiting the Microsoft 365 Service Disruption

stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence detected emails on 13 Nov posing as service-health notices about the real Exchange Online outage, warning held messages would be deleted unless users clicked a link. Microsoft called the activity consistent with credential phishing and said similar emails hit organisations across several US sectors. It said there is no sign the outage itself was caused by an attack.

stories.headline: US crude ends the week down about 2% as Gulf exports recover and the IEA now sees a Q4 surplus

sources.title: Week in Review - Oil Prices Trend Lower Following Recovery in Middle East Exports

stories.summary: WTI closed Friday at $88.79, down $2.04 on the week, with Brent near $95.71. Gulf producers are moving more oil via ship-to-ship transfers and pipelines, OPEC+ output jumped about 2m barrels a day in October, and the IEA now expects supply to exceed demand this quarter. A tanker carrying LNG struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday.
